title: MICA Composition Contract
description: Schema for mica.yaml — declares what files constitute a MICA package and how they are managed. Every field here is validated. No field exists outside this schema.

mica_spec.description: Version of the mica.yaml spec this file targets.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for this MICA package. Kebab-case recommended.

mode.description: Operational mode. memory_injection: session amnesia compensation via post-maintenance injection. protocol_evolution: iterative protocol growth via dogfood cycles.

layers.description: Ordered list of files that compose this MICA package. Must include exactly one 'archive' layer and exactly one 'playbook' layer.

update_triggers.description: Conditions under which the MICA archive should be updated. All listed triggers are validated — no undeclared values accepted.

description.description: Optional human-readable note about this MICA package's purpose.

drift_profile.description: Optional v0.2.0 Drift Profile activation. Classifies and responds to surface divergence inside the MICA-managed project.

layer.description: A single file or directory that is part of the MICA package.

name.description: Standard layer identifiers. Custom names allowed but standard names carry semantic weight.

path.description: Path relative to the project root. Use forward slashes.

format.description: File format. Determines how the AI should parse this layer.

required.description: If true, the file must exist for the MICA package to be valid. Defaults to true.

max_lines.description: Maximum allowed line count for this layer. Useful for working_memory layers to prevent unbounded growth.

loading_hint.description: Hint to the AI about when/how to load this layer.

archivePolicy.description: Controls when and how old MICA archives are rotated and retained.

rotation.description: When to create a new archive version and move the old one to history.

retention.description: How long to keep archived versions. 'indefinite' recommended for MICA (institutional memory).

driftClass.description: A single named drift class with severity and response action.

id.description: Stable identifier for this drift class. Recommended format: DRF-NNN.

label.description: Snake-case label for this drift class.

severity.description: How serious this drift class is when detected.

action.description: Session-level behavior when this drift class is detected.

driftProfile.description: Drift Profile: defines source surfaces and response classes for surface divergence detection.

enabled.description: Whether the Drift Profile is active for this package.

default_action.description: Fallback action when drift is detected but no specific class matches.

source_classes.description: Which project surfaces are compared for drift. Choose only those that actually matter.

classes.description: Named drift classes with severity and response actions.
